stem: A pollen-producing structure is found during reproductive scouting in a seedless-flower crop. What is the strongest immediate response?
choices: Ignore it because the seed source was labeled feminized
Record plant/location/time, isolate or otherwise contain the affected risk as appropriate, inspect connected plants and investigate genetic/environmental context
Assume every plant is genetically identical
rationale: Observed reproductive expression should be documented and managed by affected-scope risk rather than label assumptions.
